name: too_many_parameters
description: A private helper takes seven positional parameters; the public API must not change.

hidden_tests.tests/test_hidden_render.py:
from labels.render import render_label


def test_widths_and_defaults():
    assert len(render_label({"name": "A", "price": 1}, width=10)) == 12
    assert render_label({"name": "A", "price": 1}, 8, "left", False) == " A $1.00 "
    assert render_label({"name": "A", "price": 1}, 9, "center", True) == "| A $1.00 |"
